verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair axis for a developer platform, but the evidence does not document an assistant inside Workers or the Cloudflare dashboard that users can delegate tasks to. What it does document is adjacent: remote MCP servers and a Skills plugin for external agents such as Claude Code and Cursor, plus the Agents SDK and the Think harness for developers to build their own agents. Neither counts as a built-in assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
